name: Püski (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of yellow and blue triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Püski (a yellow and red shield with a black horseman) between the name PÜSKI above and the motto AZ IGAZ GYŐZ below in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: serrated border of yellow and blue triangles
inscriptions PÜSKI and AZ IGAZ GYŐZ
